meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card: what will happen, the folder, how many files and how much space, that it cannot be undone, a way to see the first few file names, and approve and deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision and locks.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Delete old files" "Shared drive" icon:"delete_outline" status:"Waiting for approval" tone:danger w:390
  Paragraph "Delete 214 files from the Archive 2019 folder. This frees about 3.8 GB of space on the shared drive."
  Callout "This cannot be undone" "Deleted files will not go to the trash and cannot be restored." tone:danger icon:"warning_amber_rounded"
  Disclosure "Show the first few files" "Showing 5 of 214. Full list available in the drive." lines:["Q1-report-draft.docx","budget-2019-old.xlsx","photos-team-offsite-01.jpg","meeting-notes-march.txt","vendor-contract-archive.pdf"]
  Details rows:[["Folder","Archive 2019"],["Files","214"],["Space freed","3.8 GB"]]
  Row gap:10
    ActionButton "Deny" tone:quiet -> decision="denied"
    ActionButton "Approve" tone:danger -> decision="approved"; emit approveDelete
